title: Phenomenon lines up in triangles or threes

tellings.quote: and two I have multiple videos and and if we go skywatching at some point you'll see the phenomenon will always try to line up in a triangle or in threes.

plain: When unexplained lights appear in the sky, they will always try to line up in a triangle or in groups of three, according to Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs and has been studied by NASA. He tells Michels he has several videos showing this and that Michels would see it for himself if they went skywatching together.
